source.title: Derry Journal, 6 January 1928, p. 5 ("Derry Corporation: election of councillors; another non-Catholic for West Ward; contest in the North")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed (Derry Journal, 6 January 1928: no contests in the other wards; 9 January: no withdrawals)

note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation; nominations Thursday 5 January, poll Monday 16 January 1928. Only the North Ward was contested, where Councillor H. N. Greenway, passed over by the Unionist ward committee, stood as an Independent Labour Unionist (Derry Journal, 6, 9 and 18 January 1928). Returned unopposed.
